name: Howden hybrid reciprocating compressor (horizontal/vertical)
description: Peter Brotherhood reciprocating compressors rated to 20MW and operating between 260 and 1,000 rpm also described on this page (text as printed).

specifications.basis: The Howden hybrid reciprocating compressor is available in horizontal or vertical configurations of up to five compression stages
offering pressures increases of to 450 bar while providing inter-stage cooling and purging of condensates
